title: Both integrals of the constructed projective-line datum are identity
statement: Under the finite diagonal property for the normalized arbitrary-base projective-line splitting, there is a supported diagonal class whose explicitly constructed trace-diagonal datum has both compact-support integrals identity. The shifted coefficient pullback and the actual constructed trace are those of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. The ordinary identities are those of [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals], and the comparison with compact-support integrals is [lem-asd-presented-projective-line-datum-integrals].

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Extract the supported class from the finite diagonal property. Apply the proved comparison of each constructed compact-support integral with the corresponding ordinary integral. Substitute the two identities from the diagonal property; functoriality and inverse-hom cancellation make both conjugates identity.

theorem exists_presentedFiniteP1Datum_integrals
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hdiag : finiteP1DiagonalProperty A N hA t d Y hY) :
    ∃ κ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) N A hA) 2,
      SfDiagonalKernel.Integrals A
        (SfP1Transport.datum A N hA t q e w hY (d Y hY).trace κ)
        (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Y N A hA) 1)
        (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t q hY).symm
